text:
molly: FYI hitting a perf regression on the non-chat reranker embeddings canary after the recent kernel-affinity tweak. p50 up ~28% on a 1k qps profile — KV eviction spikes in traces, and prefill seems to be over-filling token budgets. attaching quick snippets

matt: ugh — any flamegraph / trace IDs? did the kernel selector change logic for short sequences?

molly: here's an excerpt from a collected trace:
```
flame: compile_kernel_select -> prefill_batch -> kv_lookup -> kernel_exec
prefill_batch: 45ms
kv_lookup: 120ms (evictions + GC spikes)
kernel_exec: 30ms
```

anya: hmm looks like prefill is doing greedy token fill for rerank workloads. can we try a soft token target + shallower prefetch depth for embeddings endpoints? also check if affinity caused fallback to a slower kernel (non-quantized).

molly: quick A/B I ran: token_target=64 (soft) + prefetch_scale=0.3 dropped p50 to +8% vs baseline, but tail for long sequences regressed a bit. so tradeoff exists.

nick: suggestion: decouple prefetch depth from queue priority for rerank endpoints. keep small prefill for short queries, but bump queue priority so we don't starve small batches. also add a kernel veto: if kv_latency > 80ms, prefer the cached-kernel (even if affinity suggests otherwise). @infra-bot can we spin a canary with those flags?

infra-bot: scheduled canary run 2152345700 with flags: token_target=64, prefetch_scale=0.3, kernel_veto_threshold=80ms, rerank_priority_bump=1.5. will post metrics in ~30m.

matt: please also emit per-request KV_eviction_count and prefill_token_count as tracing tags — that helped on the last regression.

anya: on it. I'll add a lightweight metric and a x-request-tag for KV_evictions.

molly: thanks all — will watch the canary and post profiler snapshots. regroup after canary results (~30–40m). :thumbsup:
